Parking Spaces (Reserved): Ten (10)

Full Term: 15 Years

Firm Term: 10 Years

Option Term: One (1), five (5) year renewal option

Additional Requirements:

- The building must have a secured lobby (i.e., have a security guard/station) and the offered space must have a secondary entrance/ emergency egress.

- Offered space must be located on one (1) floor, above ground level, and in contiguous space. Non-contiguous space may be considered as an alternative. 

- The building must be located within two (2) blocks of a public bus and/or rail transportation.

- A loading dock and freight elevator are required.

- Access by the USTP staff to the building/ Office and the utilities for the use of office equipment (i.e., lighting, power, etc.) shall be provided and made available during other than normal hours of operation, at no additional charge.  Building mechanical systems (HVAC), during other than normal hours of operation, shall be made available upon request and only with advance approval and funding from the Executive Office for US Trustees.Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease.  A fully serviced lease is required.

- Generator: Inclusion of emergency power backup is required.

- Water Cistern: Provision for a potable water storage system is required.

Offered space shall not be in the 100 year flood plain.  If the offered location is in a 100-year or 500-year flood plain(s), additional requirements and approvals shall be required prior to accepting a potential offer.

Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR).  For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B.
